title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk
  • Design workflows using Zapier / Make / n8n + LLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc

  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: Python Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Python Developer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter web crawlers e scrapers
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de produto, design e operações para definir requisitos e entregar soluções eficazes;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com Python 3;
  • Conhecimentos protocolos web, como HTTP/HTTPS;
  • Experiência prática com scraping e crawling (ex: requests, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Conhecimento de cloud AWS.
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Prática em Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Clean Architecture;
  • Conhecimento de Redes de computadores;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de CI/CD utilizando github actions;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga!

title: Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced IntelliMatch (DIM) Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our reconciliation platform. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise , playing a key role in delivering scalable and efficient reconciliation solutions across global banking systems.

You will act as a technical authority , guiding development, support, and functional teams while ensuring best practices, performance, and architectural integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for IntelliMatch (DIM) solutions
  • Lead hands-on development , including configurations, enhancements, and automation
  • Design and implement SQL-based reconciliation logic and workflows
  • Establish and enforce technical standards and best practices
  • Drive integration strategies between IntelliMatch and upstream/downstream systems
  • Act as technical lead during delivery , ensuring quality across implementation, testing, and release
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on backlog prioritization and solution planning
  • Analyze existing systems to identify performance and architectural improvements
  • Maintain detailed architecture documentation and design artifacts

✅ Must-Have (Non-Negotiable Skills)

  • ✔ IntelliMatch (DIM) experience (Version 20+)
  • ✔ Strong hands-on experience in IntelliMatch architecture & development
  • ✔ Advanced SQL / MS SQL Server expertise
  • ✔ Experience in reconciliation / financial systems
  • ✔ Ability to work hands-on + architect-level

⭐ Good to Have

  • Experience with PowerShell / Python scripting
  • Exposure to Azure / cloud platforms
  • Experience with JIRA / Agile methodologies
  • Banking or financial services domain experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science / Software Engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in IntelliMatch (DIM) or similar reconciliation platforms
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior Base24 Software Developer
description:
Job Title: Base24 EPS Software Developer

Modelo de contratação:PJ

Requisito obrigatório: PJ (necessário CNPJ ativo) CNPJ ativo

Local: Remoto

Início: Imediato

Nível: Sênior

Years of Experience: 5 7 Years

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Base24 EPS Software Developer with a strong background in Base24 architecture and modules, as well as expertise in Base24. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of ATM and POS authorization principles, along with operational knowledge of the WebGate product. This role requires a proactive individual who can navigate complex systems, provide technical expertise, and collaborate effectively with business partners and external vendors.

Responsibilities:

  • Navigate through Base24 configuration structure using UI client.
  • Provide technical expertise to business partners, explaining system potential for future expansion or improvements.
  • Work closely with external vendors to coordinate troubleshooting and issue resolution across different platforms.
  • Maintain productive relationships with internal and external groups and organizations.
  • Understand business needs driving projects or system changes.
  • Act as the custodian and technical owner of Base24 installations.
  • Monitor system health, suggest improvements to streamline operations, and provide technical advice.
  • Lead the resolution of production problems in a critical manner.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Base24 EPS architecture and modules structure
  • Base24 EPS scripting
  • Base24 Classic architecture
  • ATM and POS authorization principles
  • Operational knowledge of WebGate product
  • Network protocols TCP/IP
  • NonStop Batchcom, SCF, FUP, TACL, EMS commands and navigation
  • ACI NCPCOM utility purpose, commands, and operational principles
  • Base24 XPNET networking configuration
  • C Programming
  • TACL macros and script writing skills
  • Stored Procedure
  • EMV, card verification, PIN security concepts

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with system health monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of software development best practices
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5 7 years of relevant experience in software development, specifically with Base24 systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • If you are a motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to contribute to innovative projects, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Senior Level


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:


  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com UX/UI Design (Prototipação);
  • Experiência com rotinas da área de UX Writer;
  • Conhecimento sobre experiência do usuário e teste de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com UX Research.


Formação: superior completo ou cursando na área de TI.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The client is looking to build and scale advanced AI-powered solutions leveraging Generative AI technologies. The project focuses on designing and implementing intelligent systems using LLMs and agentic workflows to enhance business processes and deliver high-impact, scalable products.


General information

They are seeking a senior-level AI Engineer with strong experience in Generative AI and system architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable GenAI solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and multi-agent architectures.

This role requires both hands-on technical expertise and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.


Task and Deliverables

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Design and implement GenAI-based systems (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, fine-tuning)
  • Build and orchestrate agentic workflows, including multi-agent systems and tool integrations
  • Develop scalable APIs and microservices to support AI-driven applications
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, including cloud-based integrations (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Establish evaluation frameworks to measure performance (accuracy, latency, cost)
  • Continuously optimize models and systems through feedback loops and iteration
  • Provide regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, and deliverables


Required Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering)
  • Solid understanding of AI system architecture and cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Working knowledge of Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks
  • Experience with API integration, microservices, and scalable system design
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with global stakeholders


Highlights

  • Long term (12+ monthts)
  • 40 hrs/week

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA: Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial.
  • Proficiencia em Nuvem: Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível.


Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa! A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades. Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Fique por dentro de todas as oportunidades, a qualquer momento — mesmo em movimento.

title: Senior Application Development Consultant
description:
Job Title :: Senior Application Development Consultant

Location :: Brazil Remote

Job Type :: Contract

Language Requirement: English & Portuguese are a must, Spanish is desirable

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Development Consultant with extensive experience in application development, DevOps practices, and application architecture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in utilizing the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to deliver innovative solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of application solutions using best practices in application development.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance application performance.

• Utilize the Agent Development Kit (ADK) to create robust applications that meet client requirements.

• Architect scalable and efficient application solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and team members.

• Engage with clients to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Ensure adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high-quality standards.

Mandatory Skills:

• Proven experience in application development with a strong portfolio of completed projects.

• Expertise in DevOps methodologies and tools.

• Proficient in using the Agent Development Kit (ADK).

• Strong understanding of application architecture principles.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and deployment.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

• Experience in Agile project management methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in application development and consultancy.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.

Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!


Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS. O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade. Atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores, inclusive para atendimento de clientes internacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos - Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e outros desenvolvedores para transformar requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP.
  • Conhecimento em formulários (AdobeForm, Smartforms e SapScript )
  • Conhecimento e experiência em SAP Fiori, incluindo SAPUI5 e OData.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de workflows SAP.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de relatórios, interfaces, conversões, melhoramentos e formulários
  • Capacidade de entender e traduzir especificações funcionais complexas em soluções técnicas eficazes.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas de alta complexidade.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e liderar equipes técnicas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP relevantes.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação SAP S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos em outras tecnologias SAP como SAP Gateway, AMDPs, BTP, Webdympro.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Participação em projetos internacionais ou ambientes multiculturais.


Vaga remota (apenas residentes no Brasil)

Regime de Contratação: CLT

Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.

*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Python Engineer - ArcGIS Pro
description:
Python Engineer - ArcGIS Pro

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As an experienced developer, you will work in a dynamic team on creating innovative solutions and implementing solutions from coding to testing to production deployment support

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features;
  • Implement solutions from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.

Essential Skills


  • Expertise in ArcGIS Pro;
  • Proficiency in development in Python;
  • Proficiency in Oracle SQL;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Django and Flask frameworks;

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Backend Developer Or Kotlin Backend Developer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop backend services using Kotlin
  • Build and maintain real-time data pipelines for inventory, pricing, orders, and customer activity
  • Implement event-driven systems using Kafka
  • Develop and optimize search and catalog capabilities using Elasticsearch
  • Ensure system scalability, performance, and high availability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Contribute to architecture decisions for omnichannel retail platforms

Required Skills

  • Strong backend development experience with Kotlin , 5+ years of experience
  • Experience with Kafka for event streaming
  • Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch
  • Experience building data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of microservices and API design

description:

Fabri Holdings is a forward-thinking company focused on consulting other companies to help them grow and scale til their full potential is reached. To help us, we're now looking for a Developer + AI Support Specialist that can help our clients grow with our help.

The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions, providing technical support for AI-driven systems, and troubleshooting issues. Salary

3k USD/month

title: AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Analista de IA Sênior
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Analista de IA Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA. Aqui não tem monotonia. Somos um time de solucionadores de desafios de clientes de grande porte nos mais diversos mercados.

Com desafios tão diversos, precisamos de pessoas que tenham uma boa base teórica de IA, experiência diversificada em projetos reais e a habilidade de resolver problemas novos com autonomia.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência na área de IA OU na área de desenvolvimento de software com com vivência na área de IA;
  • Experiência em conduzir projetos junto ao cliente, desde o levantamento de requisitos até as decisões técnicas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e liderança para apoiar o crescimento de profissionais com menos experiência do time;
  • Graduação em cursos da área de computação OU Pós-graduação na área de IA e experiência prévia como analista de sistemas;
  • Ter desenvolvido ao menos um projeto real com IA Generativa (não vale só prompt engineering, ok?);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções em ambiente de cloud, preferencialmente GCP ou Azure;
  • Python fluente;
  • Inglês avançado (ao menos para leitura e compreensão oral).



Desejável:

  • Experiência previa como analista de sistemas;
  • Experiência em projetos de visão computacional;
  • Certificações Cloud.




Benefícios:

Plano de saúde

Plano odontológico

Wellhub (Gympass)

Espaço Saúde - promove a saúde e bem-estar aos nossos colaboradores, dando suporte com atendimento médico ( presencial ou online) para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida.

Terapia online

Seguro de vida em grupo

Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

Vale transporte

Universidade corporativa (E-learning com diversos cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

Speexx (cursar até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

Convênio farmácias (descontos em medicamentos)

Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

Day off no seu aniversário

Programa de acompanhamento às gestantes (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras e cônjuges de colaboradores)

Programa Minha nova parceria de confiança (para novos pais, mães e cônjuges) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro



Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

The personal data collected will be used exclusively for the recruitment process and processed according to the security guidelines introduced by Atos.

If you have any questions related to privacy or any aspect related to processing activities, you can contact us by e-mail:

Click here to access our privacy notice and to get to know more about Atos processing of personal data.

title: Analista de IA Sênior
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Analista de IA Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA. Aqui não tem monotonia. Somos um time de solucionadores de desafios de clientes de grande porte nos mais diversos mercados.

Com desafios tão diversos, precisamos de pessoas que tenham uma boa base teórica de IA, experiência diversificada em projetos reais e a habilidade de resolver problemas novos com autonomia.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência na área de IA OU na área de desenvolvimento de software com com vivência na área de IA;
  • Experiência em conduzir projetos junto ao cliente, desde o levantamento de requisitos até as decisões técnicas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e liderança para apoiar o crescimento de profissionais com menos experiência do time;
  • Graduação em cursos da área de computação OU Pós-graduação na área de IA e experiência prévia como analista de sistemas;
  • Ter desenvolvido ao menos um projeto real com IA Generativa (não vale só prompt engineering, ok?);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções em ambiente de cloud, preferencialmente GCP ou Azure;
  • Python fluente;
  • Inglês avançado (ao menos para leitura e compreensão oral).



Desejável:

  • Experiência previa como analista de sistemas;

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.
  • Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience.
  • QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify \"Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment.
  • Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Junior Data Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Junior Data Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.


Mandatory Skills :

  • 3+ years Hands-on experience leading the modeling, development and deployment of Data & Analytics solutions;
  • Agile Methodologies;
  • At least experience in 3-4 projects with Multidimensional data modeling;
  • Cloud Services (AWS) data applications building and data pipelines creation/curation;
  • Database programming advanced level (AWS Redshift, SQLDW, Postgres, SQL expert);
  • Strong understanding of Linux and distributed systems is a plus;
  • Experience with Kubernetes is required; Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform);
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins) and GitOps practices;
  • Knowledge of application metric monitoring tools and logs (Grafana, Kibana, Cloud Logging/Log based metrics, etc.);
  • Knowledge of open-source table formats (Delta Lake and Iceberg);
  • Previous experience on serverless architecture (Spark, glue, Lambda functions);
  • Previous experience with Stored Procedures and UDF’s and Talend tool;
  • Multidimensional modeling (Star Schema and Snowflake) and Data Warehouse concepts


Desirable Skills:

  • High level of autonomy & good communication;
  • Opening to understand what has been required by the PO;
  • Adaptability;
  • Good attitude and insatiable hunger for knowledge is an extreme mandatory item


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and Improve an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines;
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues.
  • Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake.
  • Demonstrated experience with container orchestration technologies. Implement data ingestion pipelines, transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency.


Key Words:

  • Agile;
  • AWS;

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.
